subject: MdeModulePkg/NetworkCommon: Add PCD for USB network periodic timer
reasons: This commit replaces a single hardcoded constant NETWORK_COMMON_POLLING_INTERVAL with a PCD PcdUsbNetworkPeriodicTimerInterval in one call site.
The change touches only one call to UsbEthInterrupt and involves adding a new PCD declaration — primarily additive infrastructure work.
Too narrow (single call site) and PCD introduction is not a structural C pattern Coccinelle can express meaningfully.
No repetitive transformation across multiple files or functions.
